correctness.rationale: Projection injectivity gives the Singleton ceiling 16. If 16 were attained, all ten coordinate-pair projections would contain four diagonal pairs, requiring 40 equal-coordinate incidences, but symbol weight two allows at most two per word and hence at most 32. The explicit 15-word witness is checked directly. Equality at 15 forces at least 30 and at most 30 incidences, yielding the composition and missing-diagonal structure.
